findings.summary: Canonical command surface still exposes auto-test instead of qa.
Current auto-test command has no first-class session/login-state schema or .beacon/qa/sessions governance surface.
browser-use adapter remains conservative and fallback-driven; agent-browser/browser-use are not yet formal first-class QA orchestration surfaces.
Current auto-test create/status model does not define requirement-delta-aware QA evolution from PRD/user-story/test-case changes.
